definition: max smoothed dQ/dV on [3.80,4.15] V
reliability_rule: Full interval and reliable monotonic CC curve required

definition: Q(4.0 V)-Q(3.8 V), interpolated on chronological CC charge curve
reliability_rule: Both voltage crossings required

definition: 0.2 / partial_charge_ah
reliability_rule: Capacity must exceed 1e-5 Ah

definition: Voltage at largest interior IC peak in [3.80,4.15] V
reliability_rule: Interior peak and reliable IC curve required

definition: Integral of smoothed dQ/dV over fixed [3.80,4.15] V
reliability_rule: Full interval required; fixed window, no chemical peak assignment

definition: Width of largest interior peak at half prominence
reliability_rule: Interior peak with prominence >=5% height and bounded flanks

definition: Mean smoothed dV/dQ on uniform Q grid between 3.8 and 4.0 V
reliability_rule: Positive capacity span and reliable curve

definition: Maximum smoothed dV/dQ over same partial-capacity grid
reliability_rule: Positive capacity span and reliable curve

definition: Elapsed active CC time t(4.0)-t(3.8)
reliability_rule: Both crossings required, rests excluded

definition: Sum observed step duration for voltage <4.18 V charge samples
reliability_rule: No recording gaps or mid-step starts

definition: Sum observed durations at voltage >=4.18 V with decaying current
reliability_rule: CV voltage range <=0.035 V and current decrease >=20%

definition: Negative OLS slope of log(I) against cumulative active CV time
reliability_rule: At least 8 CV points, current decay >=20%, R2>=0.8

definition: Integral I dt at voltage >=4.18 V within verified CV phase
reliability_rule: Verified CV and contiguous samples

definition: Current IC peak voltage minus first earlier valid reference peak
reliability_rule: First available cycle missing; baseline is strictly earlier

definition: Current partial Q minus first earlier valid partial Q
reliability_rule: First available cycle missing; no future information

definition: Median finite positive recorded internal resistance, candidate audit only
reliability_rule: Not a usable input until instrument measurement quality is verified

definition: Current minus first earlier verified resistance
reliability_rule: Unavailable until resistance measurement quality verified

definition: Median CC charging current / 1.35 Ah
reliability_rule: At least 5 CC samples

definition: One if verified CV phase exists, zero if charge exists without CV
reliability_rule: Missing if no measured charge

definition: Mean measured temperature during charging
reliability_rule: Unavailable until column units and sensor validity verified

definition: V(rest+60s)-V(rest start), first post-charge rest
reliability_rule: Rest >=60s and near-zero current; not an instantaneous jump

definition: (max-min) peak height across SG windows 7,11,15 / median
reliability_rule: All windows available; >0.2 marked unstable

definition: Median finite positive resistance readings before verification
reliability_rule: Descriptive only; values in (0,1) Ohm

definition: Median same-cycle discharge current magnitude / 1.35 Ah
reliability_rule: AUDIT ONLY: excluded from predictive inputs to avoid future protocol leakage
